newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide and PPG extend links.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide and PPG extend links.

text.p: PPG Industries, a global producer of coatings, fiber glass, glass and chemicals, said it expanded its partnership with Emery Worldwide.
In a new two-year contract, Emery will act as a primary carrier for heavy weight shipments on an international basis.
PPG also renewed its existing contract with the carrier for an additional two years as primary air freight carrier for shipments of 50 pounds and more throughout North America.
"We have been pleased with Emery's service domestically and had begun to utilize their services for some European moves," said Bob Thomas, PPG manager of international transportation.

"On that basis, we asked the company to bid on this new international business, along with five other potential suppliers. Ultimately, Emery was awarded the contract based on its ability to meet our key criteria," he said.
The Emery/PPG partnership began in 1993 when Emery moved glass, paint and chemical products throughout North America.
